gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-titillium-web: Open and spread out: Bruno Ace SC has no calligraphic thinning anywhere, just expressive, distinctive letters. And Titillium Web, with stroke ends set far apart, carries that openness into a contemporary, approachable body.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-trispace: Bruno Ace SC lays out wide, open apertures with no tapering where strokes meet or end, which gives it an expressive streak. Trispace does the quiet work, sparse and widely set with curves opening outward.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Bruno Ace SC is expressive and distinctive, its open apertures running through every letter without any calligraphic thinning. Tsukimi Rounded keeps the openness with round forms like open parentheses.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tuffy: Expressive, spaced-out, and sure of itself. Bruno Ace SC keeps its apertures open without calligraphic thinning, while Tuffy sketches with a pencil that never presses harder, its s widely parted.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-varela: Varela gives its t a crossbar and stem of one width, and its c shapes look like a wide mouth. But Bruno Ace SC does the showing off, with open apertures and no calligraphic thinning.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-varela-round: Bruno Ace SC is expressive and distinctive, with open apertures and no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Varela Round sits next to it modern and clean, its counters framed by same-width strokes.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-varta: Lines that look traced with one marker tip define Bruno Ace SC, expressive and distinctive with open apertures. Varta then loosens things with big open eyes on every e and a.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-wix-madefor-displ: No hairlines, ever; just expressive lettering. Bruno Ace SC excels at that distinctive, open-aperture look, while Wix Madefor Display softens things with gently flared curve ends that stay apart.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ysabeau: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace SC keeps its thin joins no thinner than its stems. Ysabeau carries paragraphs forward on sweeping curves that never close up, keeping the flow approachable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ysabeau-office: Strokes that look traced with a marker give Bruno Ace SC its expressive, distinctive face, open apertures included. And Ysabeau Office echoes that openness, with an open-ended look on every curved letter.
